we are looking for an inspired person versed in audio/media technology to manage, run and help further develop our cutting-edge interactive audiovisual research laboratory "rtSOFE" in anechoic chamber, to manage our other labs (96ch loudspeaker array, 2 sound booths) and the research equipment and generally support our multimodal research and lab/group activities. This is a rare non-scientific, technical position at the Technical University of Munich, Germany, and we are looking for someone joining our team on a long-term basis even though the initial contract is limited to 2 years - it can then become permanent.
